name: Pressure gauge wall panel
brief: MK-162 Pressure gauge wall panel. Round 2, matched to the pick: a panelled wall section with a recessed dark gauge bay holding two big round dials (air and power) with green, white and red arcs, a little control strip, a pipe with a valve wheel running out of it, and a warm porthole beside it. The diegetic replacement for an air meter: Abbie walks up and reads the wall.

rounds.t: First build from the pack style and the Faceted Hero rules, no Midjourney pick yet.
Rebuilt against the Midjourney pick: chunky off-white modules held by dark bumper frames (bkit.module), warm orange windows (bkit.window), darker ground. Round 1 kept in round1/.
